book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨbi Sameria nɨbö ap nɨp manö hag ña
Pen bɨ Perisi gau manö rɨmnap apdi nɨŋla, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp, Jisas pɨg mɨdaiun, a göm, nɨp aueila kalɨp ñɨg pak ña; pen nɨbi bɨ iru nöp Jon nɨp auagla.
Pen Jisas nɨpe ke nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ñɨg pak ñaga; bɨ nɨpe gau nöp kalɨp ñɨg pak ñɨla.
Pen Perisi kai manö anɨbu rö hageila nɨŋöm Jisas ram mɨnöŋ Judia arö göm, ado gɨ ram mɨnöŋ Galili ara.
Pen adan aŋ au aramöm nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ Sameria amjaka.
Pen ram mɨnöŋ Sameria aŋ au aramöm, Sikar daun amjaka. Sikar söl anɨb au me, hadame nöp Jekop ñɨ nɨpe Josep nɨp mɨnöŋ naböŋ ap haga.
Pen Jekop ñɨg uƚöm uda u mɨdeia u me, Jisas auö auö, sɨdö aŋ laŋ magö u iru ga rö, am ñɨg uƚöm goƚ söl anɨb au asɨka.
Pen bɨ nɨpe gau nan magö raunɨg, Sikar daun anɨbu arla. Jisas ñɨg uƚöm söl au asɨk mɨdeia nɨŋöm nɨbi Sameria nɨbö ap ñɨg mɨlnɨg aua. Aueia, Jisas nɨŋöm haga, “Yɨp ñɨg mɨl ñö ñɨŋɨn,” a ga.
Hageia, nɨbi anɨbu haga, “Kale Juda nɨbi bɨ, hanɨp Sameria nɨbi bɨ nɨŋmim, asɨ masɨ gɨ aij gɨpim rö, nɨhön gɨnɨg, ‘Yɨp ñɨg mɨl ñö ñɨŋɨn,’ a gɨmön hagabön?” ö ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas pen haga, “God nan aij nɨbi bɨ ñɨnɨg gab u nɨŋmön, yad nöp ñɨg mɨl dap lɨmön a gabin yad bɨ an rö mɨdpin nɨŋbnap u, ne yɨp hagbnap, yad nöp ñɨg kamɨŋ magö ñeb ñɨbnep.
Hageia, nɨbi anɨbu haga, “Bɨ kub. Ñɨg mɨlep rin ne ap mɨdagöp; ñɨg uƚöm u rö nöp i gɨyaŋ mɨdöp. Anɨb u, ñɨg kamɨŋ magö ñeb anɨbu gai nɨbö udnabön?
Bac iƚaŋ hon Jekop ñɨg uƚöm anɨbi hanɨp ña. Ñɨg anɨbi nöp, nɨpe ke abe, ñɨ nɨpe bɨ abe ñɨŋöm, kaj sipsip nan nɨpe gau ñɨŋöm gɨmɨdal. Anɨb u, yad bɨ kub, Jekop bɨ pro, a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋban ar?” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Nɨbi bɨ ñɨg i ñɨŋnaböl gau, kalɨp kauyaŋ ñɨg nan gɨnɨg gab;
pen nɨbi bɨ ñɨg yad ñɨnö ñɨŋnaböl gau, kalɨp kauyaŋ ñɨg nan gagnab. Pen ñɨg yad ñɨnabin anɨbu ñɨŋlö, kalɨp aŋ daŋ ñɨg ilam ajöŋ rö juöl gɨ, kalɨp pör mɨdep u ñɨnab,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hageia, nɨbi anɨbu pen haga, “Bɨ kub. Yɨp ñɨg anɨbu ñö ñɨŋnö, hainö yɨp ñɨg nan gagnɨm; apem ñɨg i mɨlagnam,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Am nagamul ne paŋɨd dau,” a ga.
Hageia haga, “Yad bɨ halö wasö,” ga. Hageia, Jisas haga, “Manö anɨbu nɨŋö hagabön.
Bɨ unbö mamɨd u udna u pen bɨ mɨñi aip mɨdpil u, nagamul ne wasö. Anɨb u, nɨŋö hagabön,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, nɨbi anɨbu haga, “Bɨ kub. Yad nɨŋbin, ne bɨ God manö hagep bɨ ap.
Apɨs bac hon hadame nöp gau dum i God nɨp sabe gɨmɨdal rö, hon u rö nöp sabe gɨ mɨdpun u pen kale Juda kai hagpim, ‘Jerusalem nöp God nɨp sabe göl,’ a gɨpim,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Yad manö nɨŋö hagabin anɨbi nöŋ. Hainö dum anɨbi abe Jerusalem abe Bapi nɨp sabe gagnabim.

Kale Sameria nɨbi bɨ sabe gɨpim pen bɨ aigale bɨ rö nɨp sabe gɨpim u nɨŋagpim; pen hon Juda nɨbi bɨ, Bɨ sabe gɨmɨdun Bɨ u nɨŋbun. Nɨhön gɨnɨg: God nɨpe aige göm nɨbi bɨ ud kamɨŋ yunab u, hanɨp Juda nɨbi bɨ haga.
Ñɨn söl auub, pen mɨñi hadö auöp i, God Ana nɨpe nɨbi bɨ gasɨ ñö nɨŋöl gɨ, kale Bapi nɨp kabö rö sabe gɨnaböl; anɨg gɨnaböl u, nɨp aij gɨnab.
God nɨpe Ana mɨdöp u me, nɨbi bɨ God nɨp sabe göm, ana kalɨp aŋ daŋ nɨŋö nöp sabe göl.
Jisas anɨg hageia, nɨbi anɨbu pen haga, “Yad nɨŋbin, hainö Mesaia u apöm, hanɨp nan magöŋhalö hag ñɨ aij gɨnab,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Bɨ anɨbu me yad mɨdpin. Ne aip manö hagabul i,” a ga.

Jisas anɨg hageia nɨŋöm magö anɨbu bɨ nɨpe gau apjaköm nɨŋla, Jisas nɨbi ap aip manö gɨ mɨdailö, nɨŋöm kale pa gɨƚɨ gɨla. Pen bɨ kale ap uraköm, nɨbi u nɨp “Ne manö nɨhön mɨdöp?” a göm hagagla. Jisas nɨp u rö nöp, “Nɨhön gɨnɨg nɨbi anɨbu aip manö adɨŋ adɨŋ gajɨl?” a göm hagagla.
Pen nɨbi anɨbu, ñɨg rin u arö göm, kauyaŋ ado gɨ daun anɨbu amöm, nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila anɨb gau kalɨp haga,
“Apim, nan gau magöŋhalö gɨpin rö hag ñöb bɨ u nɨŋim! Nɨpe Mesaia u aka?” ga.
Anɨg hageia, nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau daun anɨbu arö göm, Jisas nɨp nɨŋun a göm aueila.
Pen Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau Jisas nɨp neb neb göm hagla, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ. Nan ñöŋ!” a gɨla.
Hageila, nɨpe pen haga, “Nan ñɨŋeb yad mɨdöp u kale nɨŋagpim,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, bɨ nɨpe gau kale ke nöp hag nɨŋ hag nɨŋ göm hagla, “Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap nɨp nan magö dap ñɨbal aka?” gɨla.

Pen Jisas kalɨp haga, “Kalöp nan magö anɨb gau nan göp; yɨp pen nan magö anɨb gau nan gagöp. Bapi manö haga u nöp gasɨ lajɨp me, gasɨ anɨbu nɨŋem, wög hagöp u gɨ junam a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋbin. Nan ñɨŋeb yad me u.
Pen kale manö ap hagpim, ‘Rakɨn mɨhau mɨhau mɨdöl, wid magö po gö am rɨk daunabun,’ a gɨpim u pen mɨñi anɨg hagagmim. Amgö kale u nɨŋ padimim nɨŋim! Wid wög gau po göm rɨk dauep rö mɨdöp.

Pen uri nöp, nɨbi bɨ wid po rɨk dauaböl nɨbi bɨ gau, mɨñ mɨñ göl gɨ wid po göp anɨbu rɨk dam kamɨŋ pör mɨdep mɨgan u löm, pe kale udaböl me u. Anɨb u me, nɨbɨ bɨ wid magö ranaŋ a göm dam yubal gau abe, nɨbi bɨ wid po göp rɨk dauaböl gau abe jɨm ñöm, wid po u kamɨŋ pör mɨdep mɨgan u mɨdnab u nɨŋöm, mɨñ mɨñ gɨnaböl.
Hon manö ap hagpun, ‘Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap wid magö yulö rannab, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap am rɨk daunaböl,’ a gɨpun u, nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagpun.
Yad kalöp hag yunö, am wid rɨk daubim. Wid wög anɨbu kale wög kƚö gɨmim gagpe; nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kƚö kale u gɨlö ranöb. Kale yɨharɨŋ am rɨk daumim nan aij udpim,” a ga.
Nɨbi Sameria nɨbö anɨbu am nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp haga, “Bɨ anɨbu nan gɨpin gɨpin gau magöŋhalö yɨp hag ñöb,” a ga u me, nɨbi bɨ Sameria nɨbö daun anɨbu mɨdeila gau iru nöp Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Pen Sameria nɨbi bɨ, kale Jisas mɨdeia au apöm, Jisas manö neb neb göm hagla, hon aip am mɨdaiun a gɨlö, Jisas ñɨn mɨhöp am kale aip mɨdöm,
manö hag ñö, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap halö iru nöp manö anɨbu nɨŋöm nɨp nɨŋ udla.

Pen kale anɨg göm nɨŋ udöm, nɨbi anɨbu nɨp hagla, “Mɨñi manö ne u nöp hagö nɨŋ udagpun; Jisas manö nɨpe u ke hagö nɨŋun nɨŋbun, nɨpe nöp nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i mɨdpal gau gau magöŋhalö kalɨp ud kamɨŋ yunɨg aua.
Jisas, bɨ kub ap ñɨ nɨpe u nɨp gö, kamɨŋ la
Jisas ñɨn anɨb mɨhau ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu mɨdöm, ruö ram mɨnöŋ Galili ara.
Nɨpe nöd manö ap hagöm haga, “Bɨ God manö hagep bɨ gau, ram mɨnöŋ kale ke au mɨdöm manö hagnaböl u, manö kalɨp udagnaböl,” a ga.

Pen Pasopa ñɨn u, Galili nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap am Jerusalem mɨdeila. Kale Jerusalem mɨdeila nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas nan gagep rö gau gö nɨŋla u me, Jisas uri ram mɨnöŋ Galili amjakö, kale nan gagep rö Jerusalem ga u gasɨ nɨŋöm, nɨp mɨñ mɨñ gɨla.
Pen Jisas am Galili mɨdöm, kauyaŋ Kena daun ara. Kena daun anɨbu me, nöd ñɨg yabɨƚ u gö ñɨg wain la. Pen daun pro Kapaneam au, bɨ kub ap ñɨ nɨpe nan ga.

Bɨ kub anɨbu manö ap nɨŋa, Jisas ram mɨnöŋ Judia arö göm, ap ram mɨnöŋ Galili mɨdeia. Anɨb u, Jisas mɨdeia u apöm, nɨp neb neb göl gɨ haga, “Ñɨ yad u nan gö umnɨg gab. Ne yɨŋɨd am nɨp gö kamɨŋ laŋ!” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Kale yɨharɨŋ yɨp nɨŋ udagnabim; nan gagep rö rɨmnap gɨnö nɨŋmim nöp, yɨp nɨŋ udnabim,” a ga.
Pen bɨ kub anɨbu haga, “Bɨ Kub! Auö arul! Wasö u, ñɨ yad u umnab!” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Aru! Ñɨ ne u mɨdeinab,” a ga. Anɨg hageia, Jisas nɨŋö hagöp, a göm, hada.
Adan aŋ au arö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ wög gɨ ñeb nɨpe rɨmnap ap nɨp nable paköm hagla, “Ñɨ ne u umagöp; mɨdöp,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, ñɨ yad u magö mai rö kamɨŋ löp, a göm, kalɨp hag nɨŋö hagla, “Rol sɨdö gamɨŋ ga magö u, hañ pɨböŋ ga u kamɨŋ la,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila ñɨ nap nɨpe nɨŋa, Jisas, “Ñɨ ne u mɨdeinab,” a ga magö u nöp kamɨŋ la. Anɨb u me, nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gau aip magöŋhalö Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Pen Jisas nɨpe nöd Kena apöm, nan gagep nöd nɨbö göm, ñɨg yabɨƚ u gö ñɨg wain la; hainö pen nan gagep yɨgwö aŋ nɨbö u göm bɨ kub u ñɨ nɨpe nɨp gö kamɨŋ la.
